translations.yue: 我很高興，因為我們一起解決了問題。

it-i-go-to-school-by-bus.text: I go to school by bus.

it-we-take-the-train-to-the-city.text: We take the train to the city.

it-i-would-like-two-tickets-please.text: I would like two tickets, please.

translations.yue: 我們打算從這裏坐火車去城裏。
translations.zh: 我们打算从这里坐火车去城里。

it-could-i-have-two-tickets-for-the-next.text: Could I have two tickets for the next train, please?

translations.yue: 請給我兩張下一班火車的票。
translations.zh: 请给我两张下一班火车的票。

it-please-let-me-know-when-we-reach-the-.text: Please let me know when we reach the station.

translations.yue: 到車站的時候，請告訴我。
translations.zh: 到车站的时候，请告诉我。

it-taking-the-bus-is-cheaper-than-taking.text: Taking the bus is cheaper than taking a taxi. We plan to take the train from here to the city.

translations.yue: 我昨天玩了。我上週出門了。
translations.zh: 我昨天玩了。我上周出门了。

it-yesterday-i-played-in-the-park.text: Yesterday I played in the park.

it-last-week-we-visited-a-friend.text: Last week we visited a friend.

translations.yue: 我們上週去看了一個朋友。
translations.zh: 我们上周去看了一个朋友。

translations.yue: 然後我們一起走路回家。
translations.zh: 然后我们一起走路回家。

it-yesterday-i-played-in-the-park-last-w.text: Yesterday I played in the park. Last week we visited a friend.

translations.yue: 我昨天在公園玩了。我們上週去看了一個朋友。
translations.zh: 我昨天在公园玩了。我们上周去看了一个朋友。

it-yesterday-i-went-to-the-park-and-met-.text: Yesterday I went to the park and met an old friend.

translations.yue: 我昨天去公園，遇到了一個老朋友。
translations.zh: 我昨天去公园，遇到了一个老朋友。

it-then-we-walked-home-and-talked-about-.text: Then we walked home and talked about what had happened.

translations.yue: 然後我們走路回家，聊了發生的事情。
translations.zh: 然后我们走路回家，聊了发生的事情。

it-at-first-i-was-nervous-but-in-the-end.text: At first I was nervous, but in the end I enjoyed it.

translations.yue: 開始我有點緊張，最後卻很開心。
translations.zh: 开始我有点紧张，最后却很开心。

it-yesterday-i-went-to-the-park-and-met-.text: Yesterday I went to the park and met an old friend. Last week we visited a place we had never seen before.

translations.yue: 我昨天去公園，遇到了一個老朋友。我們上週去了一個以前沒去過的地方。
translations.zh: 我昨天去公园，遇到了一个老朋友。我们上周去了一个以前没去过的地方。

it-what-are-you-going-to-do-tomorrow.text: What are you going to do tomorrow?

it-what-is-your-plan-for-the-weekend.text: What is your plan for the weekend?

translations.yue: 請建議大家一起做一件事。
translations.zh: 请建议大家一起做一件事。

it-i-will-play-tomorrow-i-rest-at-the-we.text: I will play tomorrow. I rest at the weekend.

translations.yue: 我明天要玩。我週末休息。
translations.zh: 我明天要玩。我周末休息。

it-i-am-going-to-play-outside-tomorrow.text: I am going to play outside tomorrow.

it-we-are-going-to-rest-this-weekend.text: We are going to rest this weekend.

translations.yue: 我們打算這個週末休息。
translations.zh: 我们打算这个周末休息。

it-let-us-go-together-because-it-is-more.text: Let us go together because it is more fun.

translations.yue: 我們一起去吧，因為這樣更好玩。
translations.zh: 我们一起去吧，因为这样更好玩。

it-i-agree-but-i-would-like-to-go-later.text: I agree, but I would like to go later.

translations.yue: 我同意，但是我想晚一點去。
translations.zh: 我同意，但是我想晚一点去。

it-i-am-going-to-play-outside-tomorrow-w.text: I am going to play outside tomorrow. We are going to rest this weekend.

translations.yue: 我打算明天去外面玩。我們打算這個週末休息。
translations.zh: 我打算明天去外面玩。我们打算这个周末休息。

it-tomorrow-i-am-going-to-practise-the-s.text: Tomorrow I am going to practise the skills I found difficult.

translations.yue: 我打算明天練習那些比較難的技巧。

it-this-weekend-we-plan-to-rest-before-s.text: This weekend we plan to rest before starting another busy week.

translations.yue: 這個週末，我們打算先休息，再開始忙碌的一週。
translations.zh: 这个周末，我们打算先休息，再开始忙碌的一周。

it-i-think-we-should-go-together-so-that.text: I think we should go together so that everyone can join in.

translations.yue: 我覺得我們應該一起去，讓大家都能參加。
translations.zh: 我觉得我们应该一起去，让大家都能参加。

it-i-see-your-point-but-could-we-conside.text: I see your point, but could we consider another time?

translations.yue: 我明白你的意思，不過可以考慮另一個時間嗎？
translations.zh: 我明白你的意思，不过可以考虑另一个时间吗？

it-tomorrow-i-am-going-to-practise-the-s.text: Tomorrow I am going to practise the skills I found difficult. This weekend we plan to rest before starting another busy week.

translations.yue: 我打算明天練習那些比較難的技巧。這個週末，我們打算先休息，再開始忙碌的一週。
translations.zh: 我打算明天练习那些比较难的技巧。这个周末，我们打算先休息，再开始忙碌的一周。
